mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.conversation_episode_embeddings ( embedding_id, conversation_history_id, user_id, session_id, symbol, content, embedding, metadata, created_at ) VALUES ( #{embeddingId}, #{conversationHistoryId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{symbol}, #{content}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.bdlh.runtime.handler.VectorTypeHandler}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.bdlh.runtime.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (conversation_history_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding_id = EXCLUDED.embedding_id, user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id, symbol = EXCLUDED.symbol, content = EXCLUDED.content, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, created_at = NOW()
